name: All-in-One Utilities
author: 2ByteCode

sections.description:
All-in-One Utilities is a versatile plugin that allows administrators to streamline their WordPress site by enabling only the necessary features. Reduce site overhead and manage user roles and settings efficiently with these key features.

This plugin consolidates the functionality of several popular plugins into one lightweight package:
– Default Featured Image
– Easy Username Updater
– Multiple Roles
– Disable Everything

  1. User Multiple Roles: Assign multiple roles to users during creation or editing.

  2. Username Updater: Easily update usernames for users via a dedicated action in the Users list table, with optional email notification.

  3. Default Featured Image: Choose a fallback featured image in Media Settings that is applied when posts/pages lack one.

  4. Disable Unnecessary Features: Toggle off various WordPress features (e.g., author archives, application passwords, adjacent posts, embeds, emojis) to streamline and speed up your site.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the all-in-one-utilities folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure plugin settings under ‘All-in-One Utilities’ in the WordPress admin panel.
sections.faq:
How do I update a user’s username?

Navigate to the Users list in the WordPress admin, click ‘Update Username’ next to the user, and follow the prompts to enter the new username.
